delivery_methodology: The project will be executed using an AI-enabled agile methodology characterized by short, iterative development cycles with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This approach ensures that evolving requirements are accommodated and that the solution remains aligned with client expectations.

AI tools assist in drafting documentation, generating code snippets, and automating routine tasks, while human experts review, integrate, and approve all outputs to maintain quality and relevance. Quality assurance practices are embedded throughout the delivery cycle, and any changes to scope are managed through controlled processes to ensure transparency and project stability.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to implement a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) to streamline employee data management, automate leave and attendance processes, and provide insightful workforce analytics. This initiative is critical to enhancing operational efficiency, ensuring data accuracy, and empowering both HR staff and employees with self-service capabilities.

Exist Software Labs proposes a tailored HRIS solution that integrates key functionalities such as employee information management, time and attendance tracking, leave management, and reporting dashboards. The system will be delivered using a cloud-deployed microservices architecture, ensuring scalability and reliability. Upon completion, Kalinaw Trading Corporation will have a unified platform that supports informed decision-making and improves HR service delivery.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution consolidates multiple HR functions into a single platform accessible to HR staff, management, and employees. It enables HR personnel to maintain comprehensive employee records, manage employment movements, and configure organizational structures. Employees benefit from self-service features including leave applications, profile updates, and access to payslips and certificates of employment.

The system automates leave balance computations, attendance capture, and integrates seamlessly with the payroll system to exchange relevant data. Management gains access to dashboards and reports that provide real-time insights into workforce metrics. This approach aligns with Kalinaw Trading Corporation's objectives to improve data accuracy, reduce manual processes, and enhance user experience across all branches.
technical_architecture: The HRIS is designed as a cloud-deployed microservices architecture leveraging Java and Spring Boot for backend services, React for the frontend interface, and PostgreSQL as the primary data store. This layered architecture separates concerns across presentation, business logic, and data persistence, facilitating maintainability and scalability.

Integration with external systems, such as payroll, is handled through secure APIs ensuring reliable data exchange and reconciliation. The system supports multiple environments for development, testing, and production, with robust security measures including role-based access control, audit trails, and encrypted communications. This architecture meets the performance and availability targets specified by the client.
warranty_support: The solution includes a warranty period during which any defects or issues identified will be promptly addressed and corrected at no additional cost. Defects can be reported through a defined support channel, and response times will adhere to agreed service levels.

The warranty covers functional defects and system performance issues but excludes enhancements or changes requested after acceptance. Ongoing support and maintenance beyond the warranty period are available as separate service options to ensure continued system reliability and user satisfaction.
